verdict.rationale: Coinbase ships official MCP servers in its own docs: the CDP CLI includes `cdp mcp`, which exposes every API endpoint as a tool. The Coinbase Wallet/Base MCP connects any AI assistant to balances, sends, swaps and x402 payments, with approval required for write actions. The Agentic Wallet MCP documents individual tools such as check-payment-requirements, get-wallet-balance and get-wallet-address. A probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
